name: Spatial Coherence
description: Analyzes spatial coherence across 图像
algorithm: Spatial Coherence — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes spatial coherence for image forensic analysis, informed by Corvi et al. (2023):

1. **局部Feature提取**: Dense local features (texture descriptors, color statistics, gradient properties) are extracted at each spatial location. These features characterize the local image properties at multiple scales.

2. **空间相干性测量**: The coherence of features between neighboring regions is measured — how smoothly features vary spatially. Natural images show high spatial coherence: neighboring regions share similar imaging characteristics (noise level, sharpness, color rendering).

3. **相干性MapGeneration**: A spatial coherence map is generated showing where feature coherence breaks down. In authentic images, coherence breaks occur at object boundaries, occlusion edges, and depth discontinuities. In manipulated or AI-generated images, coherence breaks may appear at unexpected locations — manipulation boundaries, generator tile edges, or within regions that should be coherent.

4. **Multi-Scale相干性分析**: Spatial coherence is analyzed at multiple spatial scales. Fine-scale coherence captures pixel-level consistency (noise, texture). Coarse-scale coherence captures structural consistency (lighting, perspective, color grading). AI generation artifacts may appear at specific scales corresponding to the generator's architecture.

5. **相干性异常评分**: The overall spatial coherence is scored against expected values. Localized coherence anomalies (regions where coherence drops without physical justification) contribute to the forensic score. The score highlights boundaries between authentic and generated/manipulated content.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 图像
输入: 原始像素数据 / 图像文件
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
处理方式: 客户端 Canvas API
色彩空间: RGB、灰度（视情况而定）
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-90% 独立准确率. 在未压缩图像上性能最佳 and 在重度JPEG压缩或社交媒体重新编码时可能降低.
source: 数字图像取证研究。基于信号处理和计算摄影原理.
useCase: 通过以下方式检测AI生成或篡改的图像： spatial coherence 分析。该方法识别AI生成特有的模式和伪影，为全面的图像取证分析做出贡献.
strengths:
• 使用 Canvas API 快速客户端处理
• 有效检测特定的AI生成伪影
• 支持常见图像格式（JPEG、PNG、WebP）
• 可与互补的分析方法组合使用
• 基于成熟的图像取证研究
limitations:
• 性能可能因图像压缩级别而异
• 社交媒体重新编码可能影响准确性
• 最好与其他取证方法结合使用
• 对经过大量处理的真实图像可能产生误报
• 有效性取决于所使用的AI生成模型

references.title: Corvi et al. (2023). On the Detection of Synthetic Images Generated by Diffusion Models. ICASSP.
Fridrich, J. & Kodovsky, J. (2012). Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images. IEEE TIFS.
